انتحلن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَحَلْنَ (intaḥalna) /in.ta.ħal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# اُنْتُحِلْنَ (untuḥilna) /un.tu.ħil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# اِنْتَحِلْنَ (intaḥilna) /in.ta.ħil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
